vocabulary.meaning_en: an idea you offer to help someone
vocabulary.example: Can I make a suggestion?

vocabulary.meaning_en: offer an idea
vocabulary.example: She made a very useful suggestion.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a talk, often with slides, to show information to people
vocabulary.example: We have an important presentation this afternoon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small device for saving and moving computer files
vocabulary.example: I saved the file on a USB stick.

vocabulary.meaning_en: keep a file on a computer
vocabulary.example: Don't forget to save your work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: remove a file from a computer
vocabulary.example: I deleted the old files.

vocabulary.meaning_en: another version of the same file or document
vocabulary.example: Do you have a copy of the report?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the place on a computer where deleted files go
vocabulary.example: Look in the recycle bin. It might still be there.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a container for things you throw away
vocabulary.example: I threw the paper in the rubbish bin.

vocabulary.meaning_en: without wanting to; accidentally
vocabulary.example: I deleted the file by mistake.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you work with
vocabulary.example: Have you asked your colleagues?

vocabulary.meaning_en: secret; only for some people to see
vocabulary.example: These documents are confidential.

vocabulary.meaning_en: all the people who work for a company
vocabulary.example: Only staff can enter this room.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the place where your new emails arrive
vocabulary.example: Check your inbox for my email.

vocabulary.meaning_en: read something carefully to find mistakes
vocabulary.example: Could you proof-read my report?

vocabulary.meaning_en: disappear suddenly
vocabulary.example: My keys have vanished!

vocabulary.meaning_en: showing good judgement
vocabulary.example: That's a very sensible idea.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not well planned or arranged
vocabulary.example: The office is very disorganised.

vocabulary.meaning_en: think and act quickly in a new situation
vocabulary.example: A good salesperson can think on her feet.

vocabulary.meaning_en: someone who is good with people
vocabulary.meaning_ar: شخص اجتماعي يجيد التعامل مع الناس
vocabulary.example: We need a real people person for this job.

fine_lines.title: Why don't you...? vs How about...?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما لتقديم اقتراح. بعد Why don't you نستخدم المصدر بدون to: Why don't you try...? وبعد How about نستخدم الفعل بصيغة -ing: How about looking...?
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both make suggestions. After "Why don't you" use the base verb: Why don't you try...? After "How about" use -ing: How about looking...?

examples.sentence: Why don't you call the client?

fine_lines.title: rubbish bin vs recycle bin
fine_lines.explanation_ar: rubbish bin هي سلة المهملات الحقيقية في المكتب، وrecycle bin هي سلة المحذوفات في الحاسوب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A rubbish bin is a real bin for waste. The recycle bin is on your computer, for deleted files.

examples.sentence: Put the old paper in the rubbish bin.
The deleted file is in the recycle bin.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to start giving an idea.
expressions.example: Can I make a suggestion? Let's meet earlier.
Why don't you try restarting the computer?

expressions.phrase: Have you tried asking your colleagues?
expressions.meaning_en: Suggest something they may not have done yet.
expressions.example: Have you tried asking your colleagues for the file?
Maybe I could help you look for it?

expressions.phrase: How about looking through your rubbish bin?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما رأيك أن تبحث في سلة المهملات؟
expressions.meaning_en: Suggest an idea with How about + -ing.
expressions.example: How about looking through your desk drawers?

expressions.meaning_en: Say you have a new suggestion.
expressions.example: I have an idea! Let's check your sent emails.

expressions.meaning_en: Praise someone for a clever idea.
expressions.example: You emailed it to me? Good thinking!

grammar.title: Making suggestions: verb forms
grammar.explanation_ar:
لكل عبارة اقتراح صيغة فعل خاصة بها:
- Why don't you + فعل مجرد: Why don't you try...
- How about + فعل بـ -ing: How about looking...
- Have you tried + فعل بـ -ing: Have you tried asking...
- Maybe I could + فعل مجرد: Maybe I could help.
grammar.explanation_en:
Each suggestion phrase takes a different verb form:
- Why don't you + base verb
- How about + -ing
- Have you tried + -ing
- Maybe I/we could + base verb
examples: Why don't you send it again?
Have you tried sending it again?
Maybe we could send it again.

questions.question: Why don't you ___ in the recycle bin?
questions.explanation_ar: بعد Why don't you نستخدم الفعل المجرد look.
questions.explanation_en: After "Why don't you" use the base verb.

questions.question: Which phrase politely starts a suggestion?
questions.explanation_ar: Can I make a suggestion? بداية مهذبة للاقتراح.
questions.explanation_en: It is a polite way to start a suggestion.

questions.question: Have you tried ___ the file to yourself?
A colleague is...
questions.explanation_en: A colleague is someone you work with.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Maybe I could to help you.

questions.question: Where do deleted computer files go?
questions.explanation_ar: الملفات المحذوفة تذهب إلى recycle bin.
questions.explanation_en: Deleted files go to the recycle bin.

questions.question: "I deleted it by mistake" means...
choices: I deleted it without meaning to

questions.question: Someone who can "think on her feet"...
questions.explanation_ar: think on your feet تعني التفكير والتصرف بسرعة.
questions.explanation_en: It means thinking and acting quickly.
